dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I have to choose a university by Friday, and I can't decide.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈtʃuːz ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ, ənd aɪ ˈkænt dɪˈsaɪd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Chiang Mai or Bangkok. On the one hand, Chiang Mai has a great English program.
dialogue.reading: ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ɔːr ˈbæŋkɑːk. ɑːn ðə ˈwʌn ˌhænd, ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈhæz ə ˈɡreɪt ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈproʊɡræm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: On the other hand, it's far from home, and I'd have to pay rent.
dialogue.reading: ɑːn ði ˈʌðər ˌhænd, ɪts ˈfɑːr frəm ˈhoʊm, ənd aɪd ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ ˈrɛnt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Have you made a list of pros and cons?
dialogue.reading: hæv juː ˈmeɪd ə ˈlɪst əv ˈproʊz ən ˈkɑːnz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, but it's still a tough decision. Mom wants me to stay in Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ɪts ˈstɪl ə ˈtʌf dɪˈsɪʒən. ˈmɑːm ˈwɑːnts miː tə ˈsteɪ ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What about an alternative? You could study in Bangkok and do an exchange semester later, like I did.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ən ɔːlˈtɜːrnətɪv? juː kʊd ˈstʌdi ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ənd ˈduː ən ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ səˈmɛstər ˈleɪtər, ˈlaɪk aɪ ˈdɪd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a good idea. But I really want to live on my own.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. bʌt aɪ ˈriːli ˈwɑːnt tə ˈlɪv ɑːn maɪ ˈoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I understand. On the one hand, being independent is exciting. On the other hand, you'll miss home.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. ɑːn ðə ˈwʌn ˌhænd, ˈbiːɪŋ ˌɪndɪˈpɛndənt ɪz ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ. ɑːn ði ˈʌðər ˌhænd, juːl ˈmɪs ˈhoʊm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You're right. I'll talk to Mom and Dad again tonight.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. aɪl ˈtɔːk tə ˈmɑːm ənd ˈdæd əˈɡɛn təˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good. And remember, I'll support you either way.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ənd rɪˈmɛmbər, aɪl səˈpɔːrt juː ˈiːðər ˈweɪ.
